rec.name: Cart Gift Wrap Upsell
rec.status: Built — A/B test set up in Ablyft (March 2025); result not documented

what.text: An upsell block in the cart (drawer) that offers the shopper a gift-wrapping add-on, shown as an add-to-cart product offer. It uses the Sectionfy.io section 'CRO | Cart | Up-/Cross-Selling'. Products already in the cart are not offered again as upsells.

why.text: Many buyers are willing to pay a little extra for attractive gift packaging, especially when buying for a gift occasion. Showing the offer in the cart, right before checkout, presents it as a low-effort add-on to an order the shopper has already decided on. This raises average order value and revenue per order. Hiding items already in the cart keeps the offer relevant and avoids clutter.

how.text: 1) Install the Sectionfy.io Cart Up-/Cross-Selling section in the cart or cart drawer of the (duplicated) A/B test theme. 2) Configure the gift-wrap product as the upsell item. 3) Exclude any product already in the cart from the upsell list. 4) Make sure the upsell re-renders when the cart changes. On GIVE LOVE the cart theme code could not render Liquid dynamically, which caused three bugs: the upsell did not appear on the first add until the cart was closed and the page reloaded, the list did not update when new items were added, and upsells stayed visible after being added. The developer fixed these. 5) Set up the A/B test in Ablyft with control (no upsell) against the variant (gift-wrap upsell), and check in the first days that KPIs are tracked correctly.

items: Exclude products already in the cart (logic requested and added)
Section placement inside the cart or cart drawer
Heading and copy of the upsell block (assumed, not confirmed in source)

dependencies.text: Sectionfy.io section 'CRO | Cart | Up-/Cross-Selling'. A gift-wrap product or variant must exist in Shopify (assumed). A/B testing tool Ablyft (the script was in the theme, the customer account had to be clarified). The cart must re-render dynamically: complex or older themes need extra JS or section-rendering work, which was the main effort here (DEV estimate 4h).

items: Upsell attach rate (gift wrap added / carts)
